_note: Part 2 of the WSL artifact classification: what the platform neither holds nor needs, plus the two categories that must never be touched (credentials) or must never be deleted (ephemeral).

.bashrc.e: shell rc; its cargo env line is a known dead pointer (~/.cargo/env does not exist), recorded in the step-4 measurement

.hermes.e: a SECOND Hermes home inside WSL (1,431,156,516 B, 50 files). This host's Hermes home is the Windows profile; the platform reads neither. Read-only history.

.profile.e: shell profile; line 30 points at the same missing ~/.cargo/env

.ssh.e: 4 files, 3,183 B: CREDENTIALS. Excluded from every archive by policy -- the freeze tarball is the repo source tree only, and no secret value was read while building this manifest.

Downloads.e: one 34,227,446 B agent-q platform startup status JSON from 2026-08-02; a snapshot of the absorbed line

__pycache__.e: regenerable bytecode, 11,799 B. Never delete: move, and only with a manifest.

aipro2.e: 13 files, 213,657 B, one untracked run-evolution.mjs; no v19 counterpart by name

backups.e: 5 tarballs, 1,502,556,293 B (agent-q 1.31 GB + aura + jarvis, v17/v18-era). Historical snapshots of the same lineage the freeze bundle already preserves; nothing in v19 reads them, and the rule is archive never delete.

hermes-archive.e: 38,428,740 B across 4 files; a Hermes-side archive bundle, no v19 counterpart by name

kb_bridge.py.e: WSL-side knowledge-bridge script (1,329 B); no v19 counterpart by name

reports.e: 39,108 B across 6 files; older report output, no v19 counterpart by name

seed_ddr.py.e: WSL-side seeding script (3,953 B); no v19 counterpart by name

start-anythingllm.sh.e: no v19 artifact names anythingllm; the service was not part of this platform

start-bridge.sh.e: the WSL-side bridge launcher; v19's own kernel replaced the bridge role, but no counterpart file is named, so this is not called superseded

voicebox.e: no v19 artifact names voicebox (checked swarm_v2_artifacts/) -- and no claim is made that it is superseded, because none was verified

warm_bridge.py.e: WSL-side glue script (7,389 B); no v19 counterpart by name
